The '''plague wasp''' was a creature from [[Delphon/Legends|Delphon]].

==History==
These creatures lived in hives and apparently carried plagues. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] once remarked while on [[Formos/Legends|Formos]] that having an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officer watch his movements was as welcome as a hive of Delphon plague wasps.
